local_non_model_tests.evidence_basis: Observed command outputs before terminal commit; existing tests are synthetic unit/metadata checks, not model experiments.

external_model_weight_files.reason: Original HF weight snapshots are external inputs not bundled repository artifacts; cloud instance already stopped. Existing revision/shard attestations preserved.

verification_hash_policy: Canonical index uses Git-clean blob SHA256 plus current working-tree Git-clean hash equality; existing artifact manifests and row hashes remain strict raw-byte/canonical-JSON checks.
historical_manifest_resolution: Archived documents use the recorded relocation map; older source/policy hashes resolve at their declared historical commits, not against replacement versions. Ignored local drafts/caches are not promoted into canonical evidence.
terminal_command_policy: Only read-only verification allowlist; experiment module/worker/adapter lifecycle entrypoints fail closed. No environment bypass.

post_publication_requirements.attestation_destination: external append-only .capability-gate-program-closeout-20260910 publication attestation; avoids self-referential rewrites of the sealed tree
